chunks: But those who did not believe and called Our revelations lies, will be given disgraceful punishment.
ai.seo_question: What is the punishment for those who deny God's signs?
ai.summary: In the context of Surah Al-Hajj, this verse highlights the ultimate consequence for disbelievers who not only reject faith but actively deny the divine signs (Ayat), resulting in a humiliating punishment (Adhabun Muhin). Shia exegesis often emphasizes that this humiliation stems from the internal degradation of the soul due to persistent denial, contrasting with the honor granted to the faithful. The verse serves as a warning that mere rejection leads to a state of disgrace both in this world and the hereafter.
